title: Phone calls from Earl Warren, Claude Hopkins, Roy Eldridge and Buddy Rich
summary: The tape is stopped for phone calls from old friends, which both men call spiritual coincidences.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: ...Let me get this... Sitting here talking to you is a very - I don't know how to express these vibrations, but I'm sure on the tape the telephone which I would like to always remain in this tape, rang a couple of times and we stopped the tape just to answer the phone; the first time it was an old buddy who was in the Basie Band, Earl Warren, calling. Very spiritual. Then behind that Claude Hopkins, the great piano player of our era -
...Then I said I believe I better call and check with Roy Eldridge and I called and spoke to Roy. Before we hung up -
Before Roy could get off the phone the other phone rang and who was it but Buddy Rich...
Traps...These are things that nobody, the three

and a fourth billion peoples of the world will not know, how small the world is with an airplane and a telephone, how could you and I be sitting here 'way away from everybody and all these things come into place?
Buddy Rich was calling from Florida...
And I asked him about his father. His father is in his eighties... because I've only known Buddy since he was 6 years old.
Right. Now we want to get back to you, but I thought we should mention that as a sort of a spiritual vibration thing -
Of course, that's the way music operates.
